::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 8 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P. 90
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
We sent the 11 copies to make your dozen by rail the same day that the single copy was sent you by post <u>Feb:27</u>.[I](people/person_939.qmd) have seen in the parcels book the signature of the clerk at the Golden Cross booking office. I have sent down to enquire about it. Perhaps you could enquire at your end. The address was quite clear <u>Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester</u> I am sending you a copy of the gilt-edged cover by the post.[^1]

Yours very truly
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: This refers to *The Pupils of St. John the Divine*, which was published in one volume, as the first in the [Sunday Library](organizations/other_145.qmd), and advertised as cloth 4*s.*, gilt edges 4*s.* 6*d.*.
